fieldNotes.resolution: Roster coord (44.91914, -93.40308, ROOFTOP) landed on the east edge of the main DC building. Confirmed UNFI/SUPERVALU Distribution Center, 300 2nd Ave S, Hopkins MN 55343 via Waze, dcontrol, TruckMap, businessyab and an NLRB case (UNFI Wholesale Inc, formerly SuperValu Wholesale Operations Inc). Legacy-SuperValu conventional-grocery DC - the Minneapolis-metro hub.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck checkpoint confirmed. z19-z20 imagery shows a distinct red-roofed guard booth straddling the inbound truck lane on the NE side of the main building, with a long covered canopy/awning over the lane. The property is perimeter-fenced (chain-link visible in 2025 Street View).
fieldNotes.guardShack: The red-roofed structure between the truck lanes is a classic staffed guard booth (~1-3 vehicle footprint, set beside/in the lane with a canopy). This is a guarded entry - the SuperValu conventional-grocery DC profile.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a staffed guard shack is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck court and trailer drop yard inside the gate, before the dock doors - ample internal queuing (`staging` boxed at the gate apron).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal truck approach from the guard booth to the north-face docks; holds well over 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide truck court and gate apron with unused paved width - clear room to stripe an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~130 dock doors across the campus - the main DC north face is a long continuous bank, and the separate west building has its own dock bank. Large legacy-SuperValu DC; exact count uncertain from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple large trailer drop yards (one north of the main building, one at the west building) holding well over 50 trailers (`dropYard: true`).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock clusters on different buildings/faces (main DC north face plus the separate west building's SW face) - ship and receive operations run from distinct dock banks.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 3 buildings: the main DC, a separate large west warehouse with its own docks, and a smaller building plus offices.
fieldNotes.railServed: No freight rail spur enters the property. The tracks running alongside the adjacent highway are the Metro Green Line LRT extension, not a freight spur.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Hopkins is an inner-ring suburb in the dense Minneapolis-St. Paul metro; the campus is surrounded by residential streets, commercial development and a light-rail line - Urban.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Truck lanes split around the guard booth; lane count estimated ~2 in / 2 out, uncertain from imagery.

citations.claim: UNFI's FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties, lists a distribution centre at "Hopkins, Minnesota" as of 2025-08-02. Our roster address for this record is "300 2nd Ave S, Hopkins, MN 55343".

divestitureCheck.method: Checked against UNFI's FY2025 10-K property table and against its publicly announced 2025-2026 network consolidation. UNFI has closed 12 distribution centres in six years, so presence on the 10-K list alone is not treated as proof of current operation; the announced closures were checked by name.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the FY2025 property list and not named in any announced closure

sources.covers: UNFI network optimisation, the Allentown PA closure, and Central-region consolidations

verification.claimScope: CITY-LEVEL identity only. The 10-K names the city, not the parcel. This record is `probable` rather than `confirmed` because no retrieved source ties UNFI to the specific parcel traced here.
verification.rationale: PROBABLE: UNFI's own SEC 10-K property table lists a distribution centre in Hopkins, Minnesota as of 2025-08-02, and this record sits in that city. That establishes the company operates a DC there. It does NOT establish that the parcel traced here is that DC, and no source retrieved in this pass closes that gap, so the verdict stops at probable.
